summary: Iteration 4 verifies the new Notes/Questions + AI assistant + Admin Questions Inbox feature end-to-end. Backend: 55/55 pytest cases pass (47 regression + 8 NEW TestQuestionsAndAI). Frontend: client intake wizard renders RoleDefinition + NotesQuestionsBox correctly on the Grantors step; submitting 'What exactly is a grantor?' returned a bronze-bordered AI response inline within ~3s, textarea cleared, thread item appended. Admin layout shows new 'Questions' nav link; /admin/questions renders title 'Questions Inbox', 4 count cards (Needs your reply: 8, AI answered: 10, Replied, All), question cards with client avatar/name/email/section/time-ago badge, AI response block, and either reply form OR green 'ADMINISTRATOR REPLIED' confirmation. Reply send flow works (status flips to admin_replied). Backend logs confirm '[sms-mock:no-admin-phone]' on every escalation (Twilio key blank by design) AND email fallback to admin with subject 'Client question (...)'. SMS is correctly key-gated; email fallback is LIVE via Resend.

minor.issue: Transient litellm.BadRequestError 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.005208, Max budget: 0.001' was logged once during run. The except block in ai_assistant.py correctly degrades to 'Our team will get back to you on this one shortly.' with confident=False (escalated). Consider raising the per-call budget on the Emergent LLM key or adding a 1-retry wrapper in ai_assistant.answer_question() to avoid spurious escalations on benign definitional questions. All retries during testing succeeded — the API is stable but susceptible to provider hiccups.

action_items: (LOW) Wrap ai_assistant.answer_question with one retry on BadRequestError/Budget errors so a single transient LLM hiccup doesn't escalate a question that would otherwise be answered confidently.

(LOW / nice-to-have) On AdminQuestions.jsx, the 'Replied' count card currently shows '—' when count is 0 instead of '0' — keep as a deliberate design choice OR add the explicit count for parity with the other cards.
(INFO) No retesting of the entire regression suite required — all 47 prior tests still pass and the 8 new question tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_assistant.py L65: regex `^\s*CONFIDENCE:\s*(CONFIDENT|NOT_CONFIDENT)\s*\n?` correctly tolerates leading whitespace and case-insensitive prefix; if the model omits the prefix entirely the code defaults to confident=False which is the safe fallback. Good.
server.py L1119: `status = 'ai_answered' if ai_result.get('confident') else 'escalated'` — clean two-state machine. Correctly transitions to 'admin_replied' on reply. Good.
server.py L1133-1156: SMS first, email-fallback second is the right order. The fallback is wrapped in try/except so an email failure doesn't break the question POST. Good.

server.py L1218: `await send_email_notification(q['client_email'], ...)` — relies on client_email captured at question creation time. If client changes their auth email later, the reply still goes to the original address. Acceptable for current scope but worth a comment.

AdminQuestions.jsx: question cards use `data-testid="question-card-{id}"` plus `question-reply-input-{id}` and `question-reply-submit-{id}` which made automated reply testing trivial. Excellent test affordance.
NotesQuestionsBox.jsx L70: the AI response card carries `data-testid=question-ai-response-{section}` which makes the inline-response visible to tests. Good.

RoleDefinition.jsx — only used on role steps (Grantors/Trustee/Successor/Beneficiaries) per spec. Verified Grantor card appears; trust other steps via code review (imports present per the task description).

sms.py: `is_enabled()` checks all 3 Twilio env vars — TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER — and returns False if any are blank. Then `send_admin_sms` separately checks ADMIN_PHONE_NUMBER and logs '[sms-mock:no-admin-phone]'. Both branches confirmed in logs. Correct key-gating per user spec ('skip SMS for now').
Backend logs show no MongoDB ObjectId leakage in /api/admin/questions or /api/trust-cases/{id}/questions responses — both queries use {'_id': 0} projection. Good.
Old IntakeWizard MessageThread removal not verified directly but the new NotesQuestionsBox is present on the Grantors step in the location MessageThread used to occupy.

Backend test class `TestQuestionsAndAI` in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers POST /questions (confident + escalated), GET /questions?section=, GET /admin/questions (+counts +status filter), POST /admin/questions/{qid}/reply, RBAC, 404, and validation. rca of the issue: MINOR: One AI call in the test run returned 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.005208, Max budget: 0.001' from litellm. This is a per-key/per-window provider-side budget cap, not a code bug. The except block in ai_assistant.py L73 correctly catches the exception and returns {confident: False, text: 'Our team will get back to you on this one shortly.'} — exactly the safe escalation behaviour. A retry on retryable errors would prevent this minor UX regression. No data integrity issues, no crashes.
